name: What's for Dinner ETL Automation
description: High-level Zapier recipe for ETL automation (fallback if GitHub Actions unavailable)

triggers.name: Daily ETL Trigger
triggers.description: Triggers daily ETL jobs at 01:10 AM Toronto time

actions.name: Pull Meta Ads Data
actions.description: Fetches Meta ads data and stores in Supabase

actions.name: Pull TikTok Ads Data
actions.description: Fetches TikTok ads data and stores in Supabase

actions.name: Pull Shopify Orders
actions.description: Fetches Shopify orders and stores in Supabase

actions.name: Compute Daily Metrics
actions.description: Computes daily metrics from events, orders, and spend data

fallback.description: If webhook fails, use Zapier's built-in integrations

notes: This is a high-level specification. Actual Zapier implementation requires:
1. Setting up Zapier account and webhooks
2. Configuring API endpoints to receive webhook calls
3. Mapping data fields between sources and Supabase
Recommended: Use GitHub Actions (see /infra/gh-actions/nightly-etl.yml) instead of Zapier for better control and cost efficiency.
